# 2021B Question 7 {.unnumbered}

::: {.exam-question}
## Question {.question-label}

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} the normal regulation of cerebral blood flow and [**outline**]{.task-verb} physiological factors which may alter it. DO NOT discuss the effect of medications or pathology.
:::

Also asked in: [2019B Question 2](/content/exams/anzca/2019/B/2/index.qmd#examiner-comments)

:::: {#answer-structure}

## Suggested Structure

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} normal flow and its local regulation, then [**outline**]{.task-verb} physiological influences with their direction and mechanism. Keep the structure on normal physiology, excluding medications and pathology.

::: {.structure-headings}
### Normal Flow and Dependence on Continuous Supply

### Perfusion Pressure and Vascular Resistance

### Myogenic and Metabolic Autoregulation

### Carbon Dioxide, Oxygen and Temperature

### Other Physiological Influences
:::
